llm.summary: The skill is internally coherent for a Vedic astrology analysis tool: it relies on local Python scripts to parse JHora markdown, run sanity checks, and build an HTML report, and it does not request unrelated credentials or network access.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name/description (Vedic chart analysis) matches the included reference docs and Python scripts that parse JHora markdown, compute checks, and render reports. One small mismatch: the runtime instructions and scripts assume a Python runtime and external tools (Jagannatha Hora, MinerU) to produce input files, but the registry metadata lists no required binaries. This is explainable but should be noted before install.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims: local parsing and analysis of Vedic astrology reports via included Python scripts. Before installing or running it, check these points: 1) Ensure the agent runtime provides Python and that the agent is allowed to execute the scripts (SKILL.md expects 'python scripts/chart_sanity_check.py' and 'python scripts/build_report_html.py'); the registry metadata does not list Python as a required binary — confirm availability. 2) The workflow expects you to produce Jagannatha Hora exports (or convert PDFs to markdown with MinerU); those are external tools you must install separately. 3) Review the included scripts yourself (they are plain Python and appear to operate only on local files; they do not perform network calls), and run them in a sandbox if you have policy concerns. 4) The skill processes sensitive personal data (birth date/time/location and life events). Treat uploaded files as private; don't share data you wouldn't want processed by your agent environment. 5) If you need the agent to run autonomously, make sure you are comfortable with it invoking local Python scripts — the skill does not request extra credentials or hidden privileges. If any of the above are unclear, ask the skill author to explicitly declare the runtime requirement for Python and any other external tools.
